title: Phase 6 real-brief operational baseline
objective: Produce a repeatable live-run evidence package inside orchestrator artifacts for one low-risk operator workflow run, including explicit approval-path and stage-telemetry traces plus post-run script mapping metadata.
scope: In-run artifact package quality only (research/design/build/review/live_run_evidence). No standalone documentation file generation is required inside this brief.
constraints: No auth, approval, policy, schema, or dependency changes
Keep readiness/operator manifest and audit semantics backward compatible
Prefer documentation and operator guidance improvements over runtime redesign
success_criteria: Approval path evidence is captured in-run (approval_requested and approval_approved are visible in live_run_evidence or audit-linked event snapshots)
department_stage_executed evidence and stage telemetry are present as explicit live-run inputs in the artifact package (stage_totals, stage_summary, and department_stage_executed_events)
post_run_artifact_map is present and references existing operator scripts for status, audit, handoff, stage-gate, and manifest outputs
The package remains within current safety constraints and does not require auth, approval, policy, schema, dependency, or runtime redesign changes
Review acceptance is based on artifact-level evidence consistency; no additional out-of-band docs deliverables are required for this brief
assumptions: OpenClaw gateway transport is already available for department LLM routes
SQLite local operation remains the persistence baseline
Trend provider approval gating continues to use a supported provider value
Existing operator scripts remain the authoritative way to emit bundle-manifest, handoff, stage-gate, and audit export files after a run
This brief validates in-run artifact readiness only; operators generate post-run files using existing scripts after completion
raw_request: Run one real, low-risk operator brief through the approval path and produce an internally coherent artifact package. The package must explicitly show approval-path evidence, department stage telemetry, and a post-run operator script map. Keep all work inside current safety boundaries and treat post-run files as outputs of existing scripts, not as mandatory embedded deliverables of this brief.
